name: Benton City Community Market
tagline: Benton City Community Market, 806 Dale Ave. Benton City, WA
description: Benton City Community Market is a farmers market in 806 Dale Ave. Benton City, WA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
